title: A Geometric Perspective on Reward Function Updates in Inverse Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) is classically solved using Lagrangian optimisation, by jointly optimising a primal-dual problem with gradient descent to obtain the optimal reward function parameters and corresponding optimal policy. While this algorithmic view of IRL has been highly influential, gradient-based reward updates only paint a partial picture, largely ignoring the geometry of the problem in occupancy space. In this paper, we present an occupancy-space view of reward updates in IRL. We leverage the insight that both the optimal solution and its geometry in occupancy space are known, and show that the geometry along the e-geodesic (straight line in occupancy space) toward the optimal occupancy directly affects the gradient of the IRL dual problem in reward parameter space. translated_title: 逆强化学习中奖励函数更新的几何视角
translated_abstract: 逆强化学习（IRL）经典上通过拉格朗日优化来求解，即利用梯度下降联合优化一个原始-对偶问题，从而获得最优奖励函数参数及相应的最优策略。尽管这种算法视角的IRL影响深远，但基于梯度的奖励更新只描绘了问题的部分图景，很大程度上忽略了占用度量空间中该问题的几何结构。在本文中，我们提出了IRL中奖励更新的占用度量空间视角。我们利用这样一个洞察：最优解及其在占用度量空间中的几何结构均是已知的，并证明沿e-测地线（占用度量空间中的直线）朝向最优占用度量的几何结构，会直接影响奖励参数空间中IRL对偶问题的梯度。这一视角自然地启发我们用占用度量轨迹上的平均Fisher信息对对偶梯度进行预条件处理。我们证明了……
tldr: 本文从占用度量空间的几何视角重新审视逆强化学习中的奖励更新，揭示朝向最优占用度量的e-测地线几何结构与奖励参数空间中对偶梯度的直接联系，并据此提出用占用轨迹上的平均Fisher信息对对偶梯度进行预条件处理的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper offers an occupancy-space geometric perspective on reward updates in Inverse Reinforcement Learning, showing that the geometry along the e-geodesic toward the optimal occupancy directly affects the dual gradient in reward parameter space, and accordingly proposes preconditioning the dual gradient with the average Fisher information along the occupancy trajectory.
